# Zaboraa

> Zaboraa is a founder-led enterprise cloud architecture advisory specialising in VMware-to-hyperscaler migration (Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine, VMware Cloud on AWS, Nutanix NC2 on Azure), NSX-T zero-trust microsegmentation, HCX zero-downtime migration and disaster recovery. It also publishes six free, browser-based engineering tools (no sign-up needed) for sizing, migration readiness and DR planning. Founded by Wasim Sayyed, Principal Architect.

Note: Zaboraa is NOT a consumer AI image/audio/text tools site. It has no pricing plans, credits or billing. Advisory engagements start with a free briefing.

The site is a client-side app. Full plain-text content is available in /llms-full.txt.

## Free engineering tools (no login required)
- [Node & Storage Sizing Estimator](https://zaboraa.com/tools/sizing): Host count and usable storage for AVS, VMC, GCVE and Nutanix NC2, including node savings from external NFS (Azure NetApp Files, Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP). Excel export.
- [RVTools Analyzer & Wave Planner](https://zaboraa.com/tools/rvtools-analyzer): Upload an RVTools export; get a migration readiness score, blocker detection (RDMs, multi-writer disks, snapshots, old hardware versions) and HCX RAV/Bulk/Cold method per VM. Runs entirely in the browser.
- [Nutanix NC2 on Azure Assessment](https://zaboraa.com/tools/nutanix-nc2-assessment): AHV compatibility, VirtIO driver needs, NC2 node sizing (RF2/RF3) and Nutanix Move wave planning.
- [Aria Operations for Networks Engine](https://zaboraa.com/tools/aria-networks): Converts network flow data into application tiers, NSX Distributed Firewall rules and migration waves.
- [DR RPO/RTO Planner](https://zaboraa.com/tools/dr-planner): Compares SRM + vSphere Replication, Zerto, JetStream DR and Veeam; WAN bandwidth, RTO timeline, Excel and PDF export.
- [Hybrid Blueprint Generator](https://zaboraa.com/tools/design-generator): 5-step wizard producing a bill of materials, architecture diagram and executive dossier for five VMware/Nutanix migration paths.

## Proof and guidance
- [Case studies](https://zaboraa.com/case-studies): Tier-1 bank (1,240 VMs to AVS, zero downtime, 38% TCO reduction); 18-hospital network (NSX-V to NSX-T, 4,500 VMs); global freight (VMC on AWS stretched cluster, $1.4M/year saved).
- [6-phase migration roadmap](https://zaboraa.com/roadmap): RVTools discovery through HCX cutover and post-migration optimisation.
- [Resources hub](https://zaboraa.com/resources): [Knowledge base](https://zaboraa.com/resources/kb) troubleshooting articles, [tutorials](https://zaboraa.com/resources/tutorials) and [video masterclasses](https://zaboraa.com/resources/videos).
- [About the founder](https://zaboraa.com/about)
